title: Planned Wrightsville Beach skywatch broadcast through the World Forum

tellings.quote: We're going to have a group down on the beach at Rightsville. [gasps] Um about 40 of us doing a skywatch and we're going to broadcast it through the world forum.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he draws UFOs to him and whom NASA has studied, tells Michels about a skywatch he was planning: 'about 40 of us' on the beach at Wrightsville Beach, North Carolina. He says it would be broadcast through a group he calls the World Forum, so others could watch the sky with them in hope of seeing something.
